input.quote: 9.5 Termination of one Order Form does not terminate another Order Form unless Customer states that the affected Services are operationally inseparable. A termination right is in addition to, and does not exclude, any other remedy available under this Agreement or Applicable Law.
input.rationale: Section 9 provides only for-cause (9.1), insolvency (9.2) and security/SLA/law/IP termination (9.3); there is no Customer termination-for-convenience right anywhere in the Agreement (no hits for "convenience" outside the Order Form definition). The term is three years under Section 8.1 and Section 2.1 imposes a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment expressly "without reduction or termination rights," so we are locked in for a multi-year term with no no-fault exit — the playbook walk-away scenario. Added a 30-day convenience right with pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and no early-termination penalty, confirmed Vendor has no reciprocal convenience right during a term, and conformed Section 2.1 so the take-or-pay language does not negate the new right.

proposal.summary: Add Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund, bar Vendor convenience termination, and conform the 2.1 take-or-pay language.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a Customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, and confirmed Vendor has no convenience exit during a term, since the Agreement runs three years with no exit for us at all. We also conformed the take-or-pay wording in Section 2.1 so it does not override that right; if helpful we can discuss 60-90 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees.

ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination and Customer shall owe no early-termination fee, penalty, or accelerated Fees. Vendor may not terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience or without cause during the then-current term.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis, subject to Customer's termination and refund rights under this Agreement, including Section 9.4.
